about: One control group per application (docs/adr/0066-quality-of-service.mdx, decision 3): the development compositor run with a tree of the run's own standing for the person's user manager's (`scopes`), as the saturation benchmark runs it. Allo (sample/EditingProbe.tsx), the application the run starts, is placed in app.slice as a session's launcher places it; Super+Space opens Spotlight, whose first question starts the search service, placed in background.slice; `modo oscuro` finds Settings' Appearance page and Return opens it, Settings launched into a scope of its own in app.slice. Each scope holds the one process it was made for, which `oxyos-scope` placed before it ran the program: none runs in the compositor's own control group.

steps.name: Super+Space opens Spotlight, its field taking the keyboard: Allo is told it lost it
Settings' pages by the words their package declares: modo oscuro finds Appearance
Apariencia, a page of Settings, the top hit and selected: the service, started by the first question in its own scope, answers as its first crawl commits
Return opens it: Spotlight closes, and Settings is launched at its Appearance page
